No DeCA book. The 2020 model states the same 0.333 for every Afghan and Pakistani wind zone alike, which is one placeholder repeated eight times and not eight readings; the Global Wind Atlas has since read each zone's own terrain at 250 m. The LEVEL therefore comes from the atlas -- the capacity factor of the best tenth of the zone's land, net of 15% for wake, availability and electrical losses -- and only the month-to-month SHAPE is still the 2020 one, the atlas having no seasonality to give.
